verdict.rationale: Polar documents an embedded checkout that keeps users on your site instead of redirecting them, including an embedded payment-method view. For deeper integration it also offers a Checkout Session API with client-side get/update/confirm endpoints, which supports building fully API-driven flows in your own app. Missing for 10: evidence of how far the embedded components can be customized (theming, styling, layout), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the embed experience.
